pass the R calibration attribute explicitly. calibrated <- gcmsDeco(file.path(out, "GCMS_data2.cdf"),   file.path(out, "GCMS_data2_calibrated.msp"), nwindows = 3L, precluster = 32L,   psf_control = list(standard = attr(gcmsData2, "alkanes_TIC"))) } # }  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Sixteen related samples, retaining all mass channels. Compounds occur in # half the samples on average, with retention drift and concentration-dependent # widths and tails. Here the simulated quasipoisson dispersion is known. library(logconNMF) sim <- simulateGCMSSamples(samples=16L, n=1200L, k=48L,   preset="time_area", presence=0.5, irregular=0, drift=2,   family="quasipoisson", dispersion=2, seed=9118) input <- file.path(tempdir(), "GCMSprime_samples16") dir.create(input, showWarnings=FALSE) for(s in sim$samples) {   writeGCMSCDF(s$Y, file.path(input, paste0(s$sample_id, ".cdf")),     time=s$time, acquired_at=s$acquired_at) } rm(sim, s)                         # observations are read from the CDF files experiment <- gcmsDeco(input, output_dir=paste0(input, "_results"),   family=quasipoisson("identity"), dispersion=2, correlation="none",   nwindows=2L, baseline_df=4L, precluster=32L, ncores=16L,   psf_control=list(maxiter=3L),   batch=list(coupling=list(cycles=2L, initial_cycles=1L, rounds=1L, q=32L))) experiment$seconds experiment$parallel experiment$samples[c("sample_name", "compounds", "GIC")] experiment$areas plot(experiment, type="areas") plot(experiment, sample=1L, type="lines") plot(experiment, sample=1L, type="profiles", which=1:6) saveRDS(experiment$channel_groups, file.path(input, "channel_groups.rds")) } # }
